body.name: Mlin
body.type: class of probability laws representing the underlying conditional-optimal-transport information model
body.def: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Lin}}\) denotes the underlying information model of Lin et al. (2025), in which the observed laws \(\mathcal L(X,Y_0)\) and \(\mathcal L(X,Y_1)\) share the pretreatment-covariate marginal. It does not denote the compact-support and regularity class used by particular theorems in that paper.
